skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the nature of ecology, the structure of ecological systems, and the impact of human activities on ecological processes.
Analyze and evaluate ecological systems, the impact of human activities on ecological processes, and the effects of environmental pollution.
Apply ecological principles to manage environmental resources and address environmental issues.
Develop critical thinking skills to solve ecological problems and make informed decisions.
Work effectively in teams to address ecological challenges and environmental issues.
Demonstrate the ability to independently seek out and understand information to complete assignments and solve practical problems.
Understand and apply professional ethics and environmental ethics in ecological studies and environmental management.
Adhere to class rules and regulations, and show responsibility and cooperation in assigned activities.

prerequisite_courses: Cơ sở khoa học môi trường
